intermediate.pointer: On the course panel, the Network explorer's "Your network, typed and solved" view solves this field as you type it (the separator, the five wells with their flowlines, the allocation and the capacity limit, and the four branches in their drawn sense) and prints every node pressure and branch mass to six decimals.

net_header_h1_psia.evidence: A typed network mode (typedNetwork in networkLab.js: buildNetwork, solveNetwork, checkConservation, propagateStreams and solveLinearNetwork from the vendored engine) solves whatever network the learner types. Typing the prompt's field (separator 235 psia, tolerance 1e-12, the five wells in prompt order with their flowlines, allocation and capacity limit, and the four branches in their drawn sense) prints the value within tol; yourCase.test.js proves it and that the AGBADA WEST default lands on no graded answer.
